examples.arabic: هناك، الراجل بيبيع خضار طازة وبيقول: 'كام كيلو عايزة يا ست الكل؟' وأنا بقول له: 'عايزة كيلو بطاطس و اتنين كيلو طماطم من عندك'.
examples.english: There, the man sells fresh vegetables and says: 'How many kilos do you want, madam?' And I tell him: 'I want one kilo of potatoes and two kilos of tomatoes from you.'
examples.transliteration: Honak, el ragel byebaaʾ khoḍar taza w byeqool: 'Kam kilo ʾayza ya sitt el kol?' W ana baqoolloh: 'ʾAyza kilo batates w etnein kilo tamatem men ʾandak'.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: انا شايف طماطم حمرا ولمون اصفر
examples.english: I see red tomatoes and yellow lemons
examples.transliteration: ana shayef tamatem hamra we lamoon asfar

examples.arabic: امي ابتسمت وردت عليه انا كويسة الحمد لله ونقت طماطم وخيار
examples.english: My mother smiled and replied to him I am good praise be to God and picked tomatoes and cucumbers.
examples.transliteration: Ommi ebtasamet wa raddet aleyh ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah wa naqqet tomatem wa khiyar.

examples.english: I want to buy tomatoes and potatoes.
He cut the tomatoes and the onions.
examples.transliteration: Huwa qataa el tamatem wa el basal.

examples.english: I want to buy tomatoes and bread.
examples.transliteration: ana ayez eshtery tomatem wa eish
